message.content:
The fix is in `_gnutls_pkcs12_gost_string_to_key`. The repro file is exactly the crashing input. The vulnerability is that when `iter == 0`, the code calls pbkdf2 with 0 iterations, which causes nettle to abort (which in the fuzzer context manifests as a global-buffer-overflow READ 8).

Wait, but the description says "Global-buffer-overflow READ 8". Let me look at the actual function to understand the root cause. Let me look at the code around line 867.
